- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant offered interesting facts about the famous art pieces:

  - The Starry Night depicts Vincent van Gogh's view from his asylum room window in Saint Rémy de Provence at night.
  - The Scream represents the anxiety of modern man.
  - The Persistence of Memory shows melting clocks, representing the fluidity of time.
- [USER] User expressed amazement at how art can convey emotions and messages.
